task_reconstruction.official_task: 2023 MCM Problem C, restated on pages 2 and 3.
required_outputs: interval for the number of reports on 1 March 2023
effect of word attributes on the Hard Mode share
attempt distribution for EERIE with an uncertainty statement
other features of the data and a letter to the puzzle editors

section_map.summary: abstract: one paragraph per contest problem, closed by a keyword line
introduction: New York Times, rules, requirements, firstly-finally roadmap
assumptions: four flat statements, one marked for convenience
data-preprocessing: spelling repairs, one dropped row, one magnitude correction
model-establishment: twelve indicators, then the T2PL system

contributions.summary: T2PL splits players after a single attrition rate fails both shapes.
Sharing willingness explains why simulated games run too long.
Three clusters are chosen against the better index score, with the reason printed.
The rising Hard Mode share is traced to Normal Mode players going silent.

dependency_graph.label: Trend residual becomes the regression target.
Cluster label revises the forecast interval.

assumptions.summary: No shift in the general trend of daily users.
Most players make no unessential moves.
Skill is stable because experienced players leave as rookies arrive.
Players and sharers are not distinguished, for convenience.
Players know every word in the dictionary.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Five spellings repaired: probe, naive, clean, marsh, trash.
Row nymph on 2022/3/27 sums to 126 and is dropped.
Calendar map shows no weekly pattern.

verification.summary: EERIE is hard by both the simulation and the forest.

results_trace.summary: Revised interval [15111, 18327] after the hard-word adjustment.

writing_logic.summary: Each contest problem gets its own paragraph and its own number.
A model is rejected by name before its replacement is introduced.
The losing metric is printed before the decision.
The letter retells the paper as advice about one decision.

language_observations.summary: For Problem N, we build, closed by a keyword line.
However, this model failed to satisfy both, then which is named.
A number judged in the same clause: which was not satisfactory.
Surprisingly, followed by to investigate the reason.
Dear Sir/Madam, we are a group of Wordle fanatics.

visualization_observations.summary: Calendar map with no weekly band, used to drop a day-of-week term.
Fitted reports with the forecast drawn dotted; 19367 sits on the dotted part.
General players spike and collapse; loyal players stay flat.
Hard Mode share and loyal share rescaled onto one axis.
Box plots: repeated letters raise the Hard Mode share, frequent letters lower it.
Distributions before and after the sharing correction.
t-SNE projection of three clusters named from centroid attempts.
Feature correlations ranked by forest importance.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Showing the rejected model makes the split look earned.
The letter turns the analysis into a decision the editors can use.

weaknesses.summary: One strategy and one vocabulary stand for all players.
Classifier accuracy 0.68, called not particularly good by the paper.
The difficulty regression explains 9% of the residual variance.

independent_extensions.summary: Separate strategies and lexicons per player type, with the mix estimated.
Retune T2PL for the popularity curve of another game.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Open each task paragraph with For Problem N, we build.
Name both shapes a model misses before replacing it.

unresolved_questions: Which dictionary supplies the word list, and how large is it?
What Euler step and what forest depth were used?
